tools.name: skip_prices
tools.description: Guide skip hire prices in England for a UK postcode (full, like "SN1 2AB", or just the district, like "SN1"): the price for each skip size from 2 yard mini to 12 yard maxi, ex VAT, with the local Crestway page for that town when there is one.

tools.name: skip_sizes
tools.description: The standard UK skip sizes from 2 yard mini to 12 yard maxi: typical dimensions in metres, a rough black bin bag count, what each suits, where it usually goes and whether it takes heavy waste like soil and rubble.

tools.name: find_town
tools.description: Find English towns that have a Crestway skip hire page, by name or postcode district. Returns up to 5 matches with their county and page URL. Use the town name with town_skip_facts.

tools.name: town_skip_facts
tools.description: Verified local facts from a town’s Crestway skip hire page in England: guide prices, the council’s skip permit (fee, how long it takes, how to apply), the nearest recycling centres and what they take, council bulky and garden waste services, fly-tipping fines and figures, and common questions.
